subject: general
question: The Indian Constitution was the lengthiest Constitution at the time of its adoption which originally had _________ Articles.
solution:
The correct answer is__** 395.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Constitution of India came into force on 26th January 1950. **
 
• It is the world's longest for a sovereign nation.
 
• At its enactment,** it had 395 articles in 22 parts and 8 schedules.**
 
• At about **145,000 words,** it is the **second-longest active constitution**—after the Constitution of Alabama—in the world.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Constitution Day is observed on 26th November** every year as it is the day when the Constitution was made.
 
• The Constitution of India is the longest Constitution in the world.
 
• **Now the Constitution of India has 448 articles in 25 parts and 12 schedules** and to add to this all 105 amendments.
